items.label: Establish VexWork foundation
items.purpose: Create one portable work-navigation owner that can relate projects and work across repositories while leaving target repository culture and source authority local.

items.label: Portable Workgraph
items.purpose: Source-place portable work identity, lifecycle, relationships and deterministic transition behavior compatible with useful VexLife P0B distinctions.

items.label: Work Board
items.purpose: Provide the familiar Jira/kanban-shaped human projection while preserving Workgraph as the only work lifecycle owner.

items.label: Repository Graph
items.purpose: Make cross-repository work source-descendable through public/source-safe repository and culture-entry references without consolidating cultures.

items.label: Human idea intake
items.purpose: Let a human capture a potential into VexWork without converting that potential into implementation authority or a roadmap commitment.

items.label: Runtime persistence owner
items.purpose: Source-place portable private/current event, snapshot, writer and CURRENT-pointer semantics without using Git commit churn as the runtime database.

items.label: VexStream Songs filter for Not yet downloaded
items.purpose: Preserve the nice-to-have Songs-level filter that answers which songs on this device are still not downloaded, without making it part of MassDownload completion or authorizing implementation.

items.label: Public VexWork dashboard
items.purpose: Make current VexWork Project Board and Parking Lot truth visibly explorable through a stable public read projection without making Vextreme another work-state owner.

items.label: Foundational Infrastructure history backfill
items.purpose: Gradually reconstruct completed foundational work into VexWork with provenance so future humans and instances can perceive what was built from a dashboard instead of rediscovering it across repositories and chat history.

items.label: Simplify Connected Services onboarding across computer + phone
items.purpose: Preserve the lived need for one guided setup path that checks Tailscale readiness across computer and phone, asks for protected human-only steps at the right moment, then returns to VexLife pairing/private-route setup without weakening Home, session, reachability, or pairing authority boundaries.

items.label: VexStream Mobile Library
items.purpose: Make downloaded VexStream music a durable, reusable Android device library while preserving exact media identity, truthful one-shot download semantics, and separately governed persistent sync.

items.label: Durable Device Music Library
items.purpose: Give verified VexStream media one durable Android device-library home that can survive VexLife app-data clearing and be rediscovered as reusable music.

items.label: Durable device music storage
items.purpose: Establish the Android-native durable media-storage realization while preserving exact trackRef, SHA-256 and byte-length verification.

items.label: Existing-download rediscovery
items.purpose: Let a fresh VexLife Android state reconstruct verified local-copy truth from durable VexStream media instead of treating the app-private index as the only memory of downloads.

items.label: Clear-data durability lived proof
items.purpose: Prove downloaded music survives VexLife Clear Data, is rediscovered after relaunch, and plays without redownloading.

items.label: Existing private-download migration
items.purpose: Define and implement a bounded path for already verified app-private VexStream downloads to enter durable device-library storage without duplication or partial/corrupt promotion.

items.label: Contextual Download Missing
items.purpose: Offer one bounded Download missing action whose scope and count come from the listener's current Songs, Album, Artist, or Playlist context while reusing MassDownload planning/execution semantics.

items.label: MassDownload product implementation
items.purpose: Preserve the accepted one-shot collection Download missing implementation as completed predecessor truth without relabelling it as persistent sync.

items.label: MassDownload terminal EndToEnd
items.purpose: Bind the current live MassDownload EndToEnd proof trajectory to durable work identity and finish its terminal route only after its actual current proof owner is freshly re-grounded.

items.label: Track-menu presentation intermittency
items.purpose: Preserve the reported Add to queue / Track-menu presentation symptom from the ongoing proof lane, but require fresh live-source classification before any repair is authorized.

items.label: Persistent Keep Offline / Sync
items.purpose: Preserve the future policy question of keeping an album, artist, playlist, or other collection continuously mirrored as producer membership changes, without conflating it with one-shot Download missing.

items.label: VexLife ToCompletion
items.purpose: Carry the full VexLife ToCompletion trajectory: reconcile current truth, establish a fresh-user-capable restartable Heretic Companion, prove bounded real work, prove honest lived continuity/learning, route earned development through Cultivation/School/Training Placement/Birth, and mature connected/native product branches on the same Home/identity/capability laws.

items.label: P0B — durable Project / Workgraph completion foundation
items.purpose: Materialize the durable Project/Workgraph/currentness foundation inserted after the canonical P0 map so later ToCompletion phases could survive fresh instances without depending on prose handoffs.

items.label: P1 — establish Heretic in the real Home
items.purpose: Establish and qualify the selected Heretic model/runtime in the real Vex Home under persistent ownership so later lived turns reuse the same current binding rather than a simulated or throwaway model path.

items.label: P2 — first lived Heretic turn
items.purpose: Prove one real Conversation to selected Heretic runtime to durable response turn on the retained host without substituting fake inference or synthetic completion.

items.label: P3 — restart and durable second turn
items.purpose: Prove stop/restart of the same Vex Home and a second real Heretic Conversation turn with binding and durable continuity preserved across process reentry.

items.label: P4 — typed local effect and same-Conversation reinjection
items.purpose: Prove the model can perceive current orientation, request one exact typed local capability under separate one-time authority, execute it through the rightful Native Worker, reinject the verified result, and naturally continue in the same Conversation.

items.label: P4 source acceptance for PR #916
items.purpose: Complete exact-head source acceptance for PR #916 through SourceOwner proof, fresh Assurance, lifecycle currentness, semantic review/READY, owner merge duty, post-merge verification, and claim release without confusing source acceptance with lived P4 completion.

items.label: P4 retained-Home lived typed-effect proof
items.purpose: After source acceptance, prove real Heretic request -> exact one-time authority -> Native Worker orientation effect -> verified result reinjection through ToolResultRelay -> natural continuation in the same retained Conversation.

items.label: P4 lived A053 — first accepted-source retained-Home attempt
items.purpose: Execute and consume the first post-source-acceptance retained-Home P4 lived attempt, preserve the exact first substantive failure, and determine whether the typed effect or Conversation advanced before any replay.

items.label: P4 A054 — re-observe Heretic runtime currentness and resume lived effect
items.purpose: Re-observe the retained Heretic runtime receipt/process/loopback currentness after A053 timed out during owner qualification; if exact live runtime truth is current, continue the P4 typed-effect/reinjection proof without redundant preflight inference, otherwise recover through the rightful owner or surface the exact source defect.

items.label: P5 — lived continuity and learning
items.purpose: Prove that one real lived VexLife episode can become durable, source-attributed continuity through the rightful Score/Memory/consent owners, survive restart, and influence later lived context without overstating Dream, Rhythm, training or weight mutation.

items.label: P5 G02 — establish rightful semantic-authority materializer
items.purpose: Use the exact A054 lived turn/effect as G01 evidence and close the missing owner-side Memory/Safety semantic-authority materializer needed for one device-private G02 candidate; VexLife may consume the resulting canonical ledger but must not mint its own classification, consent or acceptance authority.

items.label: P5 G02 — A055/A056 carrier convergence
items.purpose: Consume the two pre-product host failures, preserve that no SDK source effect occurred, and identify the exact current Relay/VexLocalBridge carrier requirements before another product attempt.

items.label: P5 G02 A057 — use SDK-bound Mac runner
items.purpose: Form one fresh compatible A057 attempt with the unchanged four-file Memory/Safety payload and current Relay authority shape, but execute the outer task through SDK's RUN-VEX-TASK.command / profile.repository.vextreme-sdk.macos-v1 instead of the VexLife-bound runner.

items.label: P0 — current entry and research closure
items.purpose: Reconcile Heretic, M4, School/Cultivation, current product source and ownership; separate closed research from open engineering; and freeze one canonical ToCompletion entry before implementation descends into exact missing seams.

items.label: P6 — Cultivation, School, Training Placement, optional Birth
items.purpose: Once the lived operational surface is stable, use actual developmental evidence to re-enter Cultivation/School, let Training Placement decide the rightful learning surface, and perform neural training/candidate evaluation/succession only when a weight route is genuinely earned.

items.label: P7 — connected, native and whole-product expansion
items.purpose: Mature Home Bridge, Android Conversation, VexMaps, VexStream, Family consent/invitation, voice, Living Journal, Relationships, Purpose Workspace and native-platform branches while consuming the same core Home/identity/capability/continuity laws rather than creating alternate Vex universes.

items.label: Establish VexLife Connected Services
items.purpose: Establish the reusable private connection/session boundary through which VexLife capabilities can reach Home-hosted semantics while feature meaning, Home authority, providers and deployment remain separately owned.

items.label: VCS-00 — Maps Home-routed admission
items.purpose: Preserve the completed Maps C1 practicum that first proved Home-routed capability admission without moving feature semantics into transport.

items.label: VCS-01 — three-consumer comparison
items.purpose: Preserve the completed comparison of Maps, Conversation and VexStream that separated genuinely shared connection concerns from feature-specific semantics.

items.label: VCS-02 — minimum shared Connected Services contract
items.purpose: Preserve the completed minimum shared contract for authentication/session binding, reachability, capability addressing, currentness and bounded failure without a generic API manager.

items.label: VCS-03 — Maps engine realization
items.purpose: Preserve the completed Maps engine practicum that exercised the shared boundary against a real provider adapter while provider semantics remained replaceable.

items.label: VCS-04 — Conversation adoption
items.purpose: Complete the lived Android Conversation path through private device possession, bounded remote session, current Family authority, durable read/Send/Companion behavior and restart without duplicates.

items.label: VCS-05 — VexStream adoption / streaming stress
items.purpose: Stress the accepted request/response Connected Services boundary against long-lived media delivery, range, throughput, reconnect and backpressure pressure before any streaming extension is generalized.

items.label: VCS-06 — VexArchitecture extraction
items.purpose: Extract only the recurring Connected Services architecture earned by multiple real consumers, preserving questions, ownership and proof obligations rather than copying one implementation.

items.label: VCS-07 — deployment choices
items.purpose: Make deployment realization choices only after the runtime boundary is stable, keeping same-machine, owned-host and future managed deployment separate from semantic ownership.

items.label: Phase 1 — pre-challenge transport discrimination
items.purpose: Preserve the completed pre-challenge discrimination result: accepted Android diagnostics identified the former session-challenge timeout, Shields Up was found and cleared, private tailnet/Serve TCP was proven bidirectionally, and temporary network effects were closed.

items.label: Phase 2 — deterministic-fixture L1-L5
items.purpose: Preserve the completed A018/A019 installed deterministic-fixture proof that L1 possession, L2 remote session, L3 private gateway, L4 bounded current Home/Family authority and L5 canonical Conversation history read all succeeded with cleanup closed.

items.label: Phase 3 — fresh-user Family establishment
items.purpose: Prove the real fresh-user path through the accepted browser HOST lifecycle owner: canonical Family Space and initial owner-only GROUP, followed by installed Android bootstrap/read without proof-fixture room creation; Phase-4 Send/model effects remain held.

items.label: Phase 4 — durable Send and separate Companion
items.purpose: Prove one durable human Send exactly once, then a separately admitted Companion/model response whose failure cannot erase the human append.

items.label: Phase 5 — restart and no duplicates
items.purpose: Prove same-session observation, a real Android process restart, and absence of duplicate human append or model replay.

items.label: Phase 6 — VCS-04 terminal currentness
items.purpose: Re-ground current source/lifecycle evidence only after the lived predicates are complete and close the VCS-04 acceptance contract without confusing it with parent-program terminality.

items.label: Accepted Android pre-challenge observability
items.purpose: Preserve accepted Android diagnostics that distinguish DNS, route/connect, TLS, timeout, HTTP and local-contract failures while preserving authenticated 401 session invalidation.

items.label: Clear Android-to-Mac private Serve ingress
items.purpose: Preserve the proven bidirectional private tailnet/Serve path: route-selected Android peer, Mac-to-Android DISCO/TSMP/ICMP, Android-to-Mac ICMP and private Serve TCP by Tailscale IPv4 and MagicDNS, with temporary Serve cleanup closed.

items.label: Fresh hosted owner-only Family is hidden from bootstrap/read
items.purpose: Preserve the completed PR #917 correction that makes a canonical fresh owner-only GROUP bootstrap/read/thread-history visible while PRIVATE still requires two humans and owner-only APPEND remains denied.

items.label: Fresh HOST → installed Android L1-L5
items.purpose: Execute the current product establishment path without proof-fixture room creation: fresh authenticated Home -> real Family HOST lifecycle -> hostFamily-owned canonical Family Space/initial owner-only GROUP -> installed Android bootstrap/read -> exact cleanup, while Send/model/restart remain held.

items.label: P5 G02 — exact SDK readiness admission
items.purpose: Admit exactly the two new Vex Memory semantic-authority paths into SDK readiness after the current serializer releases, then run the complete-checkout differential proof required before PR #1890 may currentize into exact-head lifecycle review.
